validity_findings: Bootstrap CIs are degenerate (width=0) for TN [1.0,1.0], FA [0.0,0.0], UNKNOWN [0.125,0.125], ECE [0.0625,0.0625] due to perfectly deterministic detection (all 210 fresh retained, all 30 stale flagged). This is correctly disclosed as a ceiling effect per spec F8 (degenerate bootstrap not a falsifier at rebalanced prevalence). Wilson CIs remain informative: TN lower=0.982 (<1.0), FA upper=0.1135 (>0.0, <0.18), UNKNOWN width=0.083. Non-degenerate bootstrap would require stochastic threshold or non-deterministic site.

Sampling discrepancy from frozen spec: spec defines 180 fresh + 30 stale + 150 noise = 360 (stale_rate 30/210=0.1428). Execution produced 210 fresh + 30 stale + 150 noise = 390 (stale_rate 30/240=0.125). The extra 30 fresh are pre-drift requests (requests 1-5) from the 6 stale trajectories (2 per family × 3 families), counted as fresh in the staleness pool. This is necessary for V5 (within-family freshness std>0) and V14 (per-trajectory caching from first 3 valid). Both stale_rate values (0.125 actual, 0.1428 expected) satisfy the UNKNOWN prevalence-aware bounds [0.00,0.18] and [stale_rate±0.05/0.07]. Wilson FA upper identical at n_stale=30 (0.1135). Disclosed in validity_notes and provenance.

Constant honest sum-counter (base 4 per request) makes trajectory-grouped max |rho_shuffled| trivially 0.0 because cost variance is zero by design (V2/V3). This satisfies the honesty gate (proves no injected variance n*3200/f*6.0/parity) but does not test graded cost-outcome discrimination. Disclosed in validity_notes and provenance. Within-family freshness std=0.5 for drift families (binary stale flag) satisfies V5; cost std=0 exempted per V2 narrowing.
